title: Astratto – Modern Design Agency Website
description: A modern, responsive design agency website built with React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4. Structured using reusable components and optimized with Vite for fast performance. Focused on clean UI, branding presentation, and smooth layout flow.

title: Moviq – Streaming Platform UI
description: A modern streaming platform UI built with React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4. Designed with reusable components like Nav, Aside, and dynamic video sections for structured layout flow. Optimized using Vite for fast performance and responsive viewing experience.

title: Razorpay Clone – Fintech Landing Page
description: A responsive Razorpay-inspired fintech landing page built with React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4. Structured using modular sections like Hero, Features, Testimonials, and CTA components. Optimized with Vite for fast performance and clean UI presentation.

title: DVSY – Fashion Brand Website
description: A modern fashion brand website built with React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4. Designed with reusable components and premium typography for a clean, high-end aesthetic. Optimized using Vite for smooth performance and full responsiveness.

title: Productivity Dashboard – All-in-One Planner App
description: A feature-rich productivity dashboard built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Includes Todo List, Daily Planner, Pomodoro Timer, Goals Tracker, Weather API integration, and dynamic theme switching. Uses localStorage for persistent data and real-time updates for an interactive user experience.

title: Pokemon Saga – Interactive Pokedex App
description: An interactive Pokémon explorer built with React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and Axios. Fetches real-time data from the PokeAPI and displays dynamic stat cards with animations using Lottie. Includes batch loading, themed UI based on Pokémon type, and smooth interactive effects.

title: Contact Manager – React Form UI
description: A clean and responsive contact management interface built with React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4. Uses reusable components for contact cards and form handling with structured state management. Optimized with Vite for fast performance and smooth UI experience.

title: Web Editor – Browser-Based Design Tool
description: A browser-based visual design editor built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Supports draggable, resizable elements with layers panel, multi-page system, real-time property controls, and localStorage persistence. Includes export functionality to generate clean HTML or JSON from the created design.

title: Pinterest Style Gallery – Responsive Image Grid
description: A responsive Pinterest-style image gallery built with HTML, SCSS, Flexbox, and JavaScript DOM manipulation. Allows users to dynamically add images by title, URL, and column selection. Adapts to 4 columns on desktop and 2 columns on mobile for a smooth, flexible layout.

title: ALVY Studio Website Clone
description: A pixel-accurate clone of the ALVY Studio website featuring bold typography, smooth transitions, and a premium studio-style layout.

title: Apple Website UI Clone
description: A clean and minimal Apple website UI clone replicating Apple's visual language, spacing, and modern responsive layout.

title: Flutter Website Ecosystem
description: A modern informational webpage showcasing the Flutter ecosystem with structured sections, smooth scrolling, and a developer-focused layout.

title: Weathry – Weather App
description: A weather application that displays real-time weather information with a minimal interface and location-based data.

title: Online Piano
description: An interactive online piano that allows users to play musical notes directly from the browser using keyboard or mouse input.

title: Superhero Cards
description: A superhero-themed card-based UI showcasing characters with interactive hover effects and responsive layout.

title: Instagram Reels Section
description: A UI recreation of Instagram Reels featuring vertical video layouts and mobile-first interaction design.

title: Emoji & Alphabet Game
description: A fun educational game designed to help users learn alphabets using emojis with interactive gameplay mechanics.
